text:
maria.cs: Hey team, CourseKit just opened a ticket — they're seeing a large spike of 504s and SDK deadline_exceeded errors since ~08:10 UTC. They report client-side retries fired and their billing shows a ~2x token usage spike. Can we triage? TICKET-3245
ryan.eng: Thanks, maria. Do we have the customer request-id(s) or example timestamps? Any chance they were hitting a large prompt/embeddings batch?
ingrid.runtime: quick hit: looking at edge metrics, we have a 08:08-08:12 window with increased proxy timeouts. I see upstream keepalive resets and a backlog on the inference pool (queue_depth spiked).
--- logs snippet ---
edge-logs> filter service=proxy path=/v1/generate | where ts between 1719245400 and 1719245900 | group by upstream -> count()
  result: upstream=inf-node-42 count=312, upstream=inf-node-37 count=298
--- end ---
ryan.eng: Can the CS rep capture a failing request_id from the SDK logs? We can correlate against the gateway. Also what SDK version are they on? Older SDKs had aggressive retry defaults.
alex.support: Reached out to the customer for an example request_id and their SDK version. Sent temporary mitigation: set a client deadline to 30s and reduce parallelism to 3. They asked if Redwood has idempotency so retries don't double-charge.
maria.cs: Customer says SDK v1.10.0, default deadline 10s, they had concurrency 8. Provided example request-id: rk-0a9b3f2c.
sre-oncall: Correlated rk-0a9b3f2c -> found entry at the edge, proxied to inf-node-37, then 504 returned. Upstream shows an "kvcache_lock_wait" warn around same ts. Suspect a KV-cache contention causing requests to wait then hit client deadline.
ingrid.runtime: If kvcache lock waits are causing long p95s, some requests will hit client deadline and client retries. That lines up with billing spike. We don't currently dedupe retries at the gateway level. Recommend engineering mitigation:
- short term: raise default client deadline to 30s in support guidance
- short term: suggest customers send X-Client-Request-Id (we'll use it for correlation)
- mid term: implement idempotency/dedup path or accept "Idempotency-Key" header to suppress duplicate charge on exact retries
ryan.eng: Agree. Also pushing a change to backoff defaults in the next SDK patch to avoid retry storms (reduce retries, exponential backoff jitter).
alex.support: Customer accepted the temporary mitigation and will patch SDK settings. They're asking for ETA on permanent fix and whether there's a rollback/patch we can do server-side.
sre-oncall: We can add a rate-smoothing guard on the gateway to prevent immediate forward of retries to the inference pool for the same X-Client-Request-Id, but that's a small feature. For immediate relief I'm ramping more capacity on dedicated pool and draining inf-node-37 for deeper inspection (live now).
support-bot: deployment notifier: canary deploy inf-node-37-drain initiated by @sre-oncall at 1719245885 :rocket:
ryan.eng: Also note an auth component log showing a spike in 401->retries for one tenant due to short-lived token refresh failures. CourseKit may have had a token refresh flurry which triggered retries. Need to confirm with their auth logs.
maria.cs: I asked CourseKit to check token rotation errors and to send any auth-failure request ids. They've replied that some refresh calls returned 500 from their IdP briefly at 08:06-08:09. Could be cascading.
ingrid.runtime: Good catch — cascade of auth refresh failures + kvcache backpressure explains both the 504s and duplicate requests. Two-fold mitigation: ask customers to add idempotency keys + patch SDK backoff; we continue draining and inspect inf-node-37.
ryan.eng: Action items:
- alex.support: keep customer comms, confirm SDK config change applied and whether billing vendor sees duplicate invoice items (ASAP)
- sre-oncall: finish drain and share post-drain metrics + any root-cause logs
- ingrid.runtime: file ENG-7269 for kvcache contention analysis and gateway dedupe feasibility
- ryan.eng: prepare SDK patch (v1.10.1) to adjust retry/backoff defaults and add Idempotency-Key helper
alex.support: Will update CourseKit and ask for a screenshot of billing spike. Also offered temporary credit while we investigate. They appreciated that. :pray:
maria.cs: Customer updated: after lowering concurrency and extending deadline, errors dropped within 10 minutes. They're still watching billing but pause looks promising. I'll keep thread updated.
sre-oncall: Post-drain preliminary: queue_depth normalized, no further 504s from inf-node-37. Pushed logs to TICKET-3245.
ingrid.runtime: Filing note: we should consider exposing a recommended header soon: "Idempotency-Key" + doc snippet. Example curl for customers:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: 3f7c2a1e-9b4e-4d2a-8f1b-1c2d3e4f5a6b" \
  -H "X-Client-Request-Id: rk-0a9b3f2c" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"..."}'
```
ryan.eng: I'll target SDK patch by tomorrow EOD. ENG-7269 owners, please sync.
alex.support: Will keep customer updated and close the loop if billing vendor confirms dedupe/credit.
maria.cs: Thanks all, closing for now; will reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
